tenderSchedule.title: Tender for Labour Work of Bushing Connection, Job Locking and Gasketing Works on piece work basis for manufacture of 25KVA, 63KVA and 100KVA of Distribution Transformers on Annual Contract Basis
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Labour Work of Bushing Connection, Job Locking and Gasketing Works on piece work basis for manufacture of 25KVA, 63KVA and 100KVA of Distribution Transformers on Annual Contract Basis

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
E.M.D shall be paid at the time of uploading of Tender itself. Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under single point vender registration are exempted from Paying EMD
The Prices quoted are to be kept valid for 120 Days from the date of opening of price bid for placement of order
On Monthly basis. To be accepted for payment after 10 days from the date of receipt and acceptance of all relevant documents along with the bill - PAYMENT TEMRMS
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: GST Registration Certificate. Registration No. to be furnished and Copy of certificate to be Uploaded
ESI, PF Account Nos. to be furnished and tenderer should take Group Insurance for those workers deputed for work at KAVIKA

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: PAN Card. PAN No. to be furnished and Copy of PAN Card to be Uploaded
Copy of Income tax returns acknowledgement (ITR) for the Assessment Years 2023-2024, 2024-2025, 2025-26. Copy to be Uploaded
Audited Accounts for financial year 2022-2023, 2023-24 and 2024-25. CA certified audited accounts with UDIN no. with Financial statement shall be uploaded
The prospective bidder shall have Annual Turn Over of minimum of 12.15 Lakhs, for MSME 9.72 Lakhs in any of the preceding 3 years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Supporting documents like Audited Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Accounts duly certified by the Chartered Accountant to be Uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid Assets consisting of Cash at Bank, Term Deposits, Securities and availability of fund based credit facilities as on 01.10.2026 or as latest as possible shall not be less than 0.73 Lakhs of amount put to tender. Availability of Credit facility as per the Annexure D, issued by any Scheduled Commercial bank is to be uploaded).
